licences.notes: Words as printed in the Schirmer vocal score (Va without its apostrophe; O for Oh; in bar 15 "Va chi ti ho fatto", a misprint for the libretto's "Ma che ti ho fatto"; Leporello's repeated "no" and "sì" as the score sets them).

licences.source: G. Schirmer vocal score, New York 1900 (plate 15147, IMSLP #68957), pages 159–161, bars 1–70 of No. 14
licences.author: G. Schirmer, piano reduction as printed
licences.notes: Written out from the printed pages: the sung lines and the piano each read by two independent readers, every disagreement settled on the page by a judge, then checked bar by bar and checked again by a fresh checker (clean). The English singing translation, the stage direction and the instrument cues are left out. Allegro assai, 3/4, 70 full bars. Playback tempo: ♩ = 203 (a bar ≈ 68 a minute), about 1:02, from the median of five complete recordings (Fricsay 1958 1:01, Giulini 1959 1:08, Böhm 1977 1:08, Haitink 1984 1:00, Karajan 1985 1:02; median 1:02). Mozart gives the words Allegro assai only.
